The present invention relates to a sealing device (1, 101, 201) for sealing a packaging material (7, 107) enclosing a filling material (29) to provide portion-packed oral pouched snuff products (43). The sealing device comprises an anvil (3, 103, 203) with a first operation surface (11, 111, 211) and a sonotrode (5, 105, 205) with a second operation surface (13, 113), the anvil and the sonotrode being arranged to allow passage of the packaging material therebetween, the second operation surface being located opposite the first operation surface during operation of the sealing device. The first and second operation surfaces are arranged to weld a first portion (7a, 107a) of the packaging material to a second portion (7b, 107b) of the packaging material. At least one of the first or second operation surfaces comprises a first welding surface (11a, 111a) defining a first extension plane and a second welding surface (11b, 111b) defining a second extension plane, which has a different orientation than the first extension plane. The first and second welding surfaces are partly delimited by a cutting edge (15, 115, 215) having an extension direction along the first and second welding surfaces, such that the cutting edge separates the first welding surface from the second welding surface. The present invention further relates to an arrangement (19) for manufacturing of portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, which arrangement comprises such a sealing device. The present invention also relates to a method for portion-packing of an oral pouched snuff product.

The invention concerns a sealing apparatus (1, 101, 201) used to seal packaging material (7, 107) around a filling material (29), thereby forming individually packaged oral pouched snuff products (43). The apparatus includes an anvil (3, 103, 203) having a first operating surface (11, 111, 211) and a sonotrode (5, 105, 205) provided with a second operating surface (13, 113). The anvil and sonotrode are positioned so that the packaging material can travel between them, with the second operating surface facing the first operating surface while the apparatus is in use.

The two operating surfaces are configured to join a first section (7a, 107a) of the packaging material to a second section (7b, 107b) by welding. At least one of these operating surfaces includes a first welding region (11a, 111a), extending in a first plane, and a second welding region (11b, 111b), extending in a second plane oriented differently from the first. A cutting edge (15, 115, 215) partially bounds both welding regions and extends along them, thereby dividing the first welding region from the second.

The invention additionally encompasses a manufacturing arrangement (19) incorporating this sealing apparatus for producing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, as well as a process for packaging individual oral pouched snuff products.
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a sealing device for producing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products. These products are formed from a packaging material that encloses a filling material, such as snuff or another oral composition.

The sealing device comprises an anvil and a sonotrode arranged with opposing operation surfaces. The operation surfaces define a passage through which the packaging material can be fed. During operation, the anvil and sonotrode cooperate to weld a first portion of the packaging material to a second portion, thereby forming a sealed pouch around the filling material.

At least one of the opposing operation surfaces comprises two welding surfaces positioned in different planes. A cutting edge is arranged between these welding surfaces and extends along both of them. This configuration enables the packaging material to be welded and cut in connection with the sealing operation, facilitating the formation and separation of individual portion-packed products.

The invention further encompasses a manufacturing arrangement that includes the sealing device, as well as a method for producing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products using the described welding and cutting process.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to equipment and a method for manufacturing individual portions of oral pouched snuff. Each portion contains a predetermined quantity of filling material enclosed in a permeable packaging material. During production, the packaging material must be sealed securely around the filling material and divided into separate portions without damaging the resulting pouches or allowing the contents to escape.

To perform these operations, the packaging material is positioned between an anvil and a sonotrode. The anvil and the sonotrode cooperate to apply pressure and ultrasonic energy to selected areas of the packaging material. Their opposing working regions include welding surfaces having different orientations, with a cutting edge arranged between the welding surfaces. When the anvil and sonotrode are brought together, the welding surfaces form seals on respective sides of the cutting edge. At substantially the same time, the cutting edge separates the packaging material between the newly formed seals.

This arrangement allows adjacent pouch portions to be sealed and separated in a single processing step. The differently oriented welding surfaces help define distinct sealing zones around the filling material, while the intervening cutting edge produces a controlled division between successive portions. As a result, each separated pouch retains a closed seal, reducing the risk of leakage or opening during subsequent handling, packaging, or use.

By combining welding and cutting in one coordinated operation, the invention simplifies the manufacturing process and can reduce the number of tools and processing stations required. It also supports rapid, repeatable production of individual oral pouched snuff products with consistent dimensions and reliable seals. The configuration is therefore particularly suitable for continuous or high-speed production lines in which packaging material and filling material are supplied successively to the welding and separation station.
outputs.L5:
## The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest and most common words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it points to a specific person, place, object, or idea. When we say “the book,” we usually mean a particular book that is already known or understood.

Although it may seem insignificant, “the” brings clarity and focus to communication. Compare “I saw a dog” with “I saw the dog.” The first sentence introduces any dog, while the second refers to a specific one. This simple distinction helps speakers and readers share context.

The word also appears in famous names and expressions, such as “the Sun,” “the Internet,” and “the truth.” In each case, it suggests something unique or especially important.

Small but essential, “the” demonstrates how even the simplest words can shape meaning.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for a sealing device used to manufacture portion-packed oral pouched snuff products, including an anvil, a sonotrode, differently oriented welding surfaces, and a cutting edge separating the welding surfaces.
counterfactuals.output: A sealing device for manufacturing portion-packed oral pouched snuff products comprises an anvil and a sonotrode arranged to cooperate for ultrasonic sealing and cutting of a packaging material enclosing portions of snuff. The anvil includes a first welding surface and a second welding surface having different orientations relative to one another. A cutting edge is arranged between and separates the first and second welding surfaces. During operation, the sonotrode presses the packaging material against the anvil, whereby ultrasonic energy forms respective seals at the differently oriented welding surfaces and the cutting edge severs the packaging material between the seals. The configuration enables substantially simultaneous sealing and separation of adjacent pouch portions and facilitates formation of sealed pouch ends having different orientations, thereby supporting reliable, high-speed production with reduced leakage and material damage.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a formal “present invention” summary based on a packaging apparatus that ultrasonically welds and cuts packaging material around individual portions of oral snuff. Preserve patent-style reference numerals for the components.
counterfactuals.output:
The present invention relates to a packaging apparatus (10) and a method for forming individual packages (12) containing respective portions (14) of oral snuff. The packaging apparatus (10) comprises a feeding arrangement (16) configured to supply packaging material (18), a dosing arrangement (20) configured to deposit discrete portions (14) of oral snuff onto or between one or more webs of the packaging material (18), and a transport arrangement (22) configured to advance the packaging material (18) through the apparatus (10).

The packaging apparatus (10) further comprises an ultrasonic processing unit (24) having an ultrasonic sonotrode (26) and a cooperating anvil (28). The sonotrode (26) and the anvil (28) are arranged to receive the packaging material (18) therebetween and to apply ultrasonic energy and pressure to the packaging material (18). The ultrasonic processing unit (24) thereby forms welded seams (30) around each portion (14) of oral snuff and cuts the packaging material (18) along one or more cutting regions (32) to separate the individual packages (12). Welding and cutting may be performed simultaneously or in successive processing steps.

In certain embodiments, the anvil (28) comprises a welding surface (34) defining the welded seams (30) and at least one cutting element (36) defining the cutting regions (32). The welding surface (34) and the cutting element (36) may be configured such that each portion (14) is enclosed within a peripheral seal (38) while adjacent packages (12) are separated without substantial displacement or contamination of the oral snuff. A control unit (40) may coordinate operation of the dosing arrangement (20), the transport arrangement (22), and the ultrasonic processing unit (24) to align each portion (14) with a corresponding package region (42).

The invention further relates to a method comprising supplying the packaging material (18), arranging individual portions (14) of oral snuff at spaced locations, enclosing the portions (14) with the packaging material (18), and passing the packaging material (18) between the sonotrode (26) and the anvil (28). Ultrasonic energy is then applied to weld the packaging material (18) around the respective portions (14) and to cut the packaging material (18), thereby producing discrete, sealed packages (12) of oral snuff. The ultrasonic welding and cutting operation provides controlled seam formation, reduced thermal loading, and efficient high-speed production of individual oral-snuff packages (12).
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe, in patent language, a sealing device comprising opposing operation surfaces on an anvil and sonotrode, where at least one operation surface has two non-coplanar welding surfaces partly delimited by a cutting edge. counterfactuals.output:
A sealing device for sealing packaging material comprises an anvil and a sonotrode arranged opposite one another and having respective mutually facing operating surfaces. At least one of the operating surfaces comprises first and second welding surfaces disposed in non-coplanar relationship, each welding surface being at least partly delimited by a cutting edge configured to sever the packaging material during a sealing operation.

A manufacturing arrangement for producing sealed portion packages comprises the sealing device and a transport mechanism configured to position packaging material containing respective product portions between the anvil and the sonotrode.

A method for packing product portions comprises arranging a product portion in packaging material, positioning the packaging material between the opposing operating surfaces, moving the anvil and sonotrode relative to one another, ultrasonically welding the packaging material by means of the first and second non-coplanar welding surfaces, and cutting the packaging material along the cutting edge to form an individually sealed portion package.
